item.title: New Twilio Console – Voice 'Try It Out' Service Interruption [monitoring]

We will continue to monitor the system until full recovery is confirmed. We expect to provide another update in 30 minutes or as soon as more information becomes available

item.title: Twilio Messaging Services Was Degraded [resolved]
item.description: Twilio Messaging Services was degraded for 46 days between July 21 2026 3:28 PM and Sept 4 2026 6:00 PM Pacific Time . During this period of time, customers that sent messages with media url that contained a comma and added the messaging service sid parameter in their messages will have their messages messages incorrectly rejected with http 400 and Twilio error code 21620 .
